functional.title: Authenticate and terminate a session
functional.acceptance: Given valid credentials, create a session. Invalid credentials reveal no account detail. Logout invalidates the session.

functional.title: Enforce document access
functional.acceptance: An unrelated employee cannot list, read, download, search or export another document. An assigned reviewer sees it after submission. Administrator can inspect records.

functional.title: Create an internal document
functional.acceptance: An employee saves a title of 1–120 characters, type, content and optional deadline. Blank title or content fails without a record.

functional.title: Upload a validated binary version
functional.acceptance: Accept PDF or DOCX up to 20 MiB only after extension, content, size and malware checks. Invalid or unscanned files cannot be downloaded.

functional.title: Keep version snapshots
functional.acceptance: Saving a revision creates the next version and preserves older content. Only the owner can edit Draft or Changes requested.

functional.title: Submit a frozen version
functional.acceptance: In the limited single-stage slice, the owner assigns a different active reviewer and creates one pending review tied to the current version. Submitted content is locked. This does not complete a multi-stage organisational route.

functional.title: Decide an assigned review
functional.acceptance: In the limited single-stage slice, only the assigned reviewer can approve or return an In review document. Return requires a nonblank reason. Duplicate decisions fail. Organisational final approval may require further stages.

functional.title: Revise and resubmit
functional.acceptance: Returned content remains in history. The owner must save a new version before resubmission. A new decision references that version.

functional.title: Search within access scope
functional.acceptance: Case-insensitive title, ID and type search plus status filter returns only visible documents. Search does not disclose hidden counts.

functional.title: Record and inspect activity
functional.acceptance: Each successful mutation records actor, time, document, version and action. Return records its reason. Protected export matches visible history.

functional.title: Archive an approved record
functional.acceptance: Only administrator can archive Approved. Archived content and decisions are read-only. No hard delete exists in the initial scope.

functional.title: Reject stale updates
functional.acceptance: A stale revision token receives 409 in the backend, with no mutation or extra event. A decision cannot refer to a changed version.

functional.title: Notify the next participant
functional.acceptance: Successful submission or decision creates an in-app event. Planned delivery retries are deduplicated. Notification failure cannot lose the decision.

functional.title: Administer accounts and roles
functional.acceptance: Administrator can activate or deactivate users and assign approved roles. Deactivated users lose sessions and cannot receive new reviews.

functional.title: Export a document and its context
functional.acceptance: An authorised user downloads a current binary version or text prototype and exports history including version and decision identity.

nonfunctional.title: Server enforced security
nonfunctional.acceptance: For each protected backend endpoint, unauthenticated requests fail and unrelated users fail. Test tampered IDs and exports. HTTPS and secure cookies required for deployment.

nonfunctional.title: Atomic decisions
nonfunctional.acceptance: Across 20 simultaneous attempts to decide one pending review, exactly one decision and corresponding audit event commit. Other requests return a conflict.

nonfunctional.title: Response time
nonfunctional.acceptance: With 30 concurrent sessions and 10000 metadata records on 2 vCPU and 4 GiB RAM, 95th percentile metadata search and command latency is at most 2 seconds after warm-up. File transfer excluded.

nonfunctional.title: Recoverability
nonfunctional.acceptance: Daily encrypted backup with a 24-hour recovery point target and a 4-hour recovery time target. Restore database and file objects in a rehearsal and verify hashes and references.

nonfunctional.title: Usability and accessibility
nonfunctional.acceptance: At least 90 percent of the defined critical tasks succeed without moderator intervention in the exploratory study. Core controls support keyboard access, labelled fields and visible focus at 390 and 1366 pixel widths.

nonfunctional.title: Audit protection
nonfunctional.acceptance: Application users cannot edit or delete audit events through any API. Restrict database permissions and verify mutation rejection. Browser demo history is mutable by its local owner.

nonfunctional.title: Input and file safety
nonfunctional.acceptance: Escape user-controlled text, check CSRF for session mutations and quarantine all uploaded binaries until validated. Reject scripts, oversized files and misleading types.

nonfunctional.title: Maintainability and deployment
nonfunctional.acceptance: A clean checkout with documented configuration can start and run automated tests. CI checks forbidden transitions and protected-object scenarios. No credentials or real participant data are tracked.
